name: tokenmunim
description: Cost control for AI agents: a budget per task, a live ledger of every step, and a circuit breaker that stops loops, burn spikes and runaway spend.

taskBudgetUsd.title: Budget per task (USD)
taskBudgetUsd.description: A task that spends this much is halted. The general task, which catches work outside any task, has no budget of its own.

sessionBudgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
sessionBudgetUsd.description: Every tool call is blocked once the session has spent this much since TokenMunim started.

loopLimit.title: Loop limit
loopLimit.description: The same failing action is blocked after failing this many times in a row.

burnLimitUsdPerMin.title: Burn limit (USD per minute)
burnLimitUsdPerMin.description: Spending faster than this over two minutes pauses the agent once with a warning.
